paras: Lacertaspis lepesmei, also known commonly as Angel's five-toed skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to the Bambouto Massif, Cameroon.
L. lepesmei is named after French entomologist Pierre Lepesme.
The preferred natural habitat of L. lepesmei is rocky areas of savanna, at altitudes around 2,200 m (7,200 ft).
